description: 한국전자통신연구원_장면 분할 API [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 동영상에서 장면이 변화하는 시점을 탐지하여, 동영상을 썸네일로 요약하거나 편집을 용이하게 하는 포인트를 제공합니다. 동영상의 각 프레임의 특성 추출 후 특성이 시간적으로 크게 변화하는 시점을 탐지하여 출력합니다. 장면 분할 API는 HTTP 기반의 REST API 인터페이스로 JSON 포맷 기반의 입력... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 동영상인식, 동영상분석, 인공지능, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
